Class BedrockResourcePackPayloads

java.lang.Object
net.raphimc.viabedrock.api.resourcepack.BedrockResourcePackPayloads
public final class BedrockResourcePackPayloads extends Object
Complete Bedrock ZIPs inside ordinary Java RPs, indexed only by pack.mcmeta.
